record_title: Unique relative tau-number for cyclotomic Phi_{2p^k} when p = 3 mod 4
scientific_context: For every odd prime p congruent to 3 modulo 4 and k>=1, Phi_{2p^k} has exactly one tau-number relative to it, namely 1. The case Phi_6(x)=x^2-x+1 upgrades a 2021 computation through 10^8 to a proof.
limitations: The proof does not classify p congruent to 1 modulo 4. Originality is to the best of our knowledge. A 2023 thesis mentions an unspecified article then in preparation about a class of polynomials for which 1 is the only relative tau-number; no title, identifier, class description, or subsequently indexed matching publication was located, so possible overlap remains the principal literature risk.

artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exact-integer consistency check for seven (p,k) cases through n=10^6.
